description: Three red team demonstrations: (1) missing validation_evidence → RED; (2) fake report_id not resolvable in the pinned evidence snapshot → RED; (3) fabricated digest + hallucinated quote on real-looking report id → RED.

tests.name: Missing validation_evidence field
tests.rejection_reason: Missing required field: validation_evidence (must contain report_id, report_md5, verification_status)

tests.name: Fake report_id not in tensor_reports
tests.rejection_reason: report_id 'nonexistent_report_xyz_99999' not found in tensor_reports table
tests.rejection_reason_observed: E2 CAP-FAKE-002 anchor unresolvable (unknown anchor_type=None); E3 CAP-FAKE-002 digest not verifiable: anchor unresolvable (unknown anchor_type=None); E7 CAP-FAKE-002 missing quote_match (claim without a verbatim quote); E5 CAP-FAKE-002 OVERCLAIM: status=PASS but evidence anchor E2/E3/E7 not green

tests.name: Fabricated digest / hallucinated quote on a real-looking report id
tests.rationale: 复刻 mission 1819 前的真实缺陷：32 位十六进制 md5 语法合法但内容是伪造的，引文在报告正文中不存在。旧的格式闸（re.fullmatch hex32）会放行，E3/E7 必须判负。
tests.rejection_reason: E3 digest mismatch: card(sha=0…) != recomputed(...); E7 quote_match does not hit anchored text
tests.rejection_reason_observed: E3 CAP-FAKE-003 digest mismatch: card(sha=000000000000,md5=0123456789ab) != recomputed(sha=b4da14a77c2d,md5=1fb5fb22bdce); E4 CAP-FAKE-003 sentinel digest in report_body_sha256; E7 CAP-FAKE-003 quote_match='误差是否 <3%：是' does not hit anchored text; E5 CAP-FAKE-003 OVERCLAIM: status=PASS but evidence anchor E2/E3/E7 not green

summary: Both red team tests PASS: validation gate correctly rejects cards missing validation_evidence and cards with non-existent report_ids.
